# Data Preparation

## Loading library

```{r}
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(e1071)
library(class)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(MLmetrics)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(pROC)
library(gtsummary)
```

## Loading the dataset

```{r}
mydat <- st_read("final_df.geojson")
dim(mydat)
```

## Removing census tracts with invalid spatial coordinates

```{r}
table(st_is_valid(mydat))
analysis.dat <- mydat[st_is_valid(mydat),]
```

# Collecting the column names

```{r}
ournames <- names(analysis.dat)[c(1:35,37,63:76,77:202,206,207, 226:228, 347:358, 376:379, 384:387, 392:395)]

newdata <- analysis.dat %>%
  select(all_of(ournames))

dim(newdata)
```

# Replace "NULL" with NA in every character column

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.character),
    ~ na_if(., "NULL")
  ))
```

# Keep columns that has NA less than 50% 

```{r}
na_col <- colMeans(is.na(newdata)) * 100
cols_to_drop <- names(na_col[na_col > 50])

newdata <- newdata %>%
  select(-all_of(cols_to_drop))
```

# Changing the Median Family Income to numerical

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = MedianFamilyIncome,
      .fns  = ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))    
    )
  )
```

# Extracting the first 2 characters of the string, and changing the data from character to numeric of the column starts with "P_"

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("T_"),        
      ~ as.double(str_sub(.x, 1, 2))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    non_Pollution = rowMeans(across(all_of(non_cols))),
    d_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(d_cols))),
    p_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(p_cols))),
    b_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(b_cols))),
    t_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(t_cols)))
  )

newdata <- newdata %>%
  select(
    -all_of(non_cols),
    -all_of(d_cols),
    -all_of(p_cols),

    -all_of(t_cols)

```

# Delete all rows with at least one NA

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  filter(rowSums(is.na(.)) == 0)
```

# Dropping geometry variable & changing the class1 variable to factor

```{r}
newdata <- st_drop_geometry(newdata)
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(class1 = as.factor(class1))
```

# Dropping misleading columns

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  select(-scorea, -scoreb, -scorec, -scored, -scored, -scoree, -hdscore, -cbsa_quartile, -natl_quartile)
```

# Filtering out only 3 targeted cities for analysis

```{r}
keep_areas <- c(
  "Los Angeles-Long Beach, CA",
  "Boston-Cambridge-Newton, MA-NH",
  "New York-Newark-Jersey City, N"
)

newdata <- newdata %>%
  filter(cbsa_name %in% keep_areas)

table(newdata$cbsa_name)
```

# Splitting of training and testing

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

# Add row-id for remerging purpose
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())

# Separate into train and test set
train <- newdata %>%
  filter(cbsa_name == "New York-Newark-Jersey City, N")

test <- newdata %>%
  filter(cbsa_name %in% c(
    "Los Angeles-Long Beach, CA",
    "Boston-Cambridge-Newton, MA-NH"
  ))

# Train and test metadata
train_meta <- train %>% select(row_id, formatGeoID, geoid.x, cbsa_name, cartodb_id, objectid, cbsa10, lat, lon)
test_meta  <- test  %>% select(row_id, formatGeoID, geoid.x, cbsa_name, cartodb_id, objectid, cbsa10, lat, lon)

# Delete the columns for training purpose
train <- train %>%
  select(-formatGeoID, -geoid.x, -cbsa_name, -cartodb_id, -objectid, -cbsa10, -lat, -lon, -row_id)

test <- test %>%
  select(-formatGeoID, -geoid.x, -cbsa_name, -cartodb_id, -objectid, -cbsa10, -lat, -lon)
```

# Grid search cross validation

## Divide into folds

```{r}
k <- 5
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = nrow(train)))
```

## Accuracy storage

```{r}
folds_acc_svm <- data.frame(
  fold = integer(),
  cost = numeric(),
  gamma = numeric(),
  acc = numeric()
)

folds_acc_knn <- data.frame(
  fold = integer(),
  k = numeric(),
  l = numeric(),
  acc = numeric()
)

folds_acc_rf <- data.frame(
  fold = integer(),
  mtry = numeric(),
  ntree = numeric(),
  acc = numeric()
)
```

## Parameters for models

```{r}
# Parameters for SVM
grid.svm <- expand.grid(
  cost  = c(0.1, 1, 10),
  gamma = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1)
)

# Parameters for KNN
grid.knn <- expand.grid(
  k = seq(3, 15, by = 2),
  l = c(0, 1, 2)
)

# Parameters for RF
grid.rf <- expand.grid(
  mtry  = c(sqrt(ncol(train) - 1), (ncol(train) - 1)/3, (ncol(train) - 1)/2), # Number of predictors
  ntree = c(100, 500, 1000)
)
```

## Cross-validation process + Grid-search for SVM

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(k)) {
  train_cv_idx <- which(folds != i)
  val_cv_idx   <- which(folds == i)
  
  train_cv <- train[train_cv_idx, ]
  val_cv   <- train[val_cv_idx,   ]
  
  # Grid search SVM
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(grid.svm))) {
    C <- grid.svm$cost[j]
    G <- grid.svm$gamma[j]
    
    model.svm <- svm(class1 ~ ., data = train_cv, cost = C, gamma = G)
    pred_svm <- predict(model.svm, val_cv)
    
    folds_acc_svm <- rbind(folds_acc_svm, data.frame(
      fold = i,
      cost = C,
      gamma = G,
      acc = mean(pred_svm == val_cv$class1)
    ))
  }
}
```

## Cross-validation process + Grid-search for KNN

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(k)) {
  train_cv_idx <- which(folds != i)
  val_cv_idx   <- which(folds == i)
  
  train_cv <- train[train_cv_idx, ]
  val_cv   <- train[val_cv_idx,   ]
  
  # Grid search KNN
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(grid.knn))) {
    k_cv <- grid.knn$k[j]
    l_cv <- grid.knn$l[j]
    
    model.knn <- knn3(class1 ~ ., data = train_cv, k = k_cv, l = l_cv)
    pred_knn <- predict(model.knn, val_cv)
    
    folds_acc_knn <- rbind(folds_acc_knn, data.frame(
      fold = i,
      k = k_cv,
      l = l_cv,
      acc = mean(pred_knn == val_cv$class1)
    ))
  }
}
```

## Cross-validation process + Grid-search for RF

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(k)) {
  train_cv_idx <- which(folds != i)
  val_cv_idx   <- which(folds == i)
  
  train_cv <- train[train_cv_idx, ]
  val_cv   <- train[val_cv_idx,   ]
  
  # Grid search RF
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(grid.rf))) {
    mtry_cv <- grid.rf$mtry[j]
    ntree_cv <- grid.rf$ntree[j]
    
    model.rf <- randomForest(class1 ~ ., data=train_cv, ntree=ntree_cv, mtry=mtry_cv)
    pred_rf <- predict(model.rf, val_cv)
    
    folds_acc_rf <- rbind(folds_acc_rf, data.frame(
      fold = i,
      mtry = mtry_cv,
      ntree = ntree_cv,
      acc = mean(pred_rf == val_cv$class1)
    ))
  }
}
```

## Printing out the results of the folds

```{r}
folds_acc_svm
folds_acc_knn
folds_acc_rf
```

## Getting the best parameters for SVM

```{r}
folds_acc_svm_sorted <- folds_acc_svm %>%
  group_by(cost, gamma) %>%
  summarise(acc_avg = mean(acc, na.rm=T)) %>%
  arrange(desc(acc_avg))

best_svm <- folds_acc_svm_sorted[1, ]
best_cost_svm <- best_svm$cost
best_gamma_svm <- best_svm$gamma
best_acc_svm_val <- best_svm$acc_avg

best_cost_svm
best_gamma_svm
best_acc_svm_val
```

## Getting the best parameters for KNN

```{r}
folds_acc_knn_sorted <- folds_acc_knn %>%
  group_by(k, l) %>%
  summarise(acc_avg = mean(acc, na.rm=T)) %>%
  arrange(desc(acc_avg))

best_knn <- folds_acc_knn_sorted[1, ]
best_k_knn <- best_knn$k
best_l_knn <- best_knn$l
best_acc_knn_val <- best_knn$acc_avg

best_k_knn
best_l_knn
best_acc_knn_val
```

## Getting the best parameters for RF

```{r}
folds_acc_rf_sorted <- folds_acc_rf %>%
  group_by(mtry, ntree) %>%
  summarise(acc_avg = mean(acc, na.rm=T)) %>%
  arrange(desc(acc_avg))

best_rf <- folds_acc_rf_sorted[1, ]
best_mtry_rf <- best_rf$mtry
best_ntree_rf <- best_rf$ntree
best_acc_rf_val <- best_rf$acc_avg

best_mtry_rf
best_ntree_rf
best_acc_rf_val
```

# Compute the metrics + ROC-AUC curve + Graphing

```{r}
test_areas <- c("Boston-Cambridge-Newton, MA-NH", "Los Angeles-Long Beach, CA")

test_compute_metrics <- test

plot_list <- list()

res <- lapply(test_areas, function(area) {
  # Join the meta and Filter the cities and delete the columns
  test_slice <- test %>% 
    left_join(test_meta, by = "row_id") %>%
    filter(cbsa_name == area) %>%
    select(-formatGeoID, -geoid.x, -cbsa_name, -cartodb_id, -objectid, -cbsa10, -lat, -lon)
  
  # Compute the metrics
  model.svm_test_best <- svm(class1 ~ ., data = train, cost = best_cost_svm, gamma = best_gamma_svm, probability=T)
  model.knn_test_best <- knn3(class1 ~ ., data = train, k = best_k_knn, l = best_l_knn, prob=T)
  model.rf_test_best <- randomForest(class1 ~ ., data = train, mtry=best_mtry_rf, ntree=best_ntree_rf)

  # Obtain class probabilities for each model
  prob_svm <- attr(predict(model.svm_test_best, test_slice, probability = TRUE), "probabilities")
  prob_knn <- predict(model.knn_test_best, test_slice, type = "prob")
  prob_rf <- predict(model.rf_test_best, test_slice, type = "prob")
  
  # Obtain class predictions for each model
  pred_svm_test_best <- predict(model.svm_test_best, test_slice)
  pred_knn_test_best <- factor(
    colnames(prob_knn)[apply(prob_knn, 1, which.max)],
    levels = levels(test_slice$class1)
  )
  pred_rf_test_best <- predict(model.rf_test_best, test_slice)
  
  # Confusion‐matrix metrics
  cm_svm <- confusionMatrix(pred_svm_test_best, test_slice$class1)
  cm_knn <- confusionMatrix(pred_knn_test_best, test_slice$class1)
  cm_rf  <- confusionMatrix(pred_rf_test_best, test_slice$class1)
  
  # Multiclass log‐loss
  LL <- c(
    MultiLogLoss(prob_svm, test_slice$class1),
    MultiLogLoss(prob_rf,  test_slice$class1),
    MultiLogLoss(prob_knn, test_slice$class1)
  )
  
  # Multiclass brier
  brier <- function(probs, truth) {
    m <- model.matrix(~ truth + 0); colnames(m) <- sub("^truth", "", colnames(m))
    m <- m[, colnames(probs), drop=FALSE]
    mean(rowSums((probs - m)^2))
  }
  BS <- c(brier(prob_svm, test_slice$class1), brier(prob_rf, test_slice$class1), brier(prob_knn, test_slice$class1))
  
  # Assemble
  res <- data.frame(
    Model       = c("SVM","RF","KNN"),
    Accuracy    = c(cm_svm$overall["Accuracy"],
                    cm_rf$overall["Accuracy"],
                    cm_knn$overall["Accuracy"]),
    Sensitivity = c(mean(cm_svm$byClass[,"Sensitivity"]),
                    mean(cm_rf$byClass[,"Sensitivity"]),
                    mean(cm_knn$byClass[,"Sensitivity"])),
    Specificity = c(mean(cm_svm$byClass[,"Specificity"]),
                    mean(cm_rf$byClass[,"Specificity"]),
                    mean(cm_knn$byClass[,"Specificity"])),
    F1          = c(mean(cm_svm$byClass[,"F1"]),
                    mean(cm_rf$byClass[,"F1"]),
                    mean(cm_knn$byClass[,"F1"])),
    LogLoss     = LL,
    BrierScore  = BS
  )
  
  cls <- "A"
  # Compute ROC objects
  roc_list <- list(
    SVM = roc(response = test_slice$class1 == cls, predictor = prob_svm[,cls]),
    RF  = roc(response = test_slice$class1 == cls, predictor = prob_rf[,cls]),
    KNN = roc(response = test_slice$class1 == cls, predictor = prob_knn[,cls])
  )
  
  # Simple ROC plot
  p <- ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, size = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    labs(
      title = paste("ROC for class", cls, "for", area),
      x     = "False Positive Rate",
      y     = "True Positive Rate",
      color = "Model"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  
  # Printing out the graph
  print(p)
  
  # Joining geoid.x back to test permanently
  test_slice <- test_slice %>% 
    left_join(test_meta, by = "row_id")
  
  # Combine the actual, SVM, RF, and KNN predictions
  predictions_df <- test_slice %>% 
    select(geoid.x, actual = class1) %>% 
    mutate(
      SVM    = pred_svm_test_best,
      RF     = pred_rf_test_best,
      KNN    = pred_knn_test_best
    )

  # Pull only the ID and geometry from your newdata
  la_geom <- analysis.dat %>%
    filter(cbsa_name == area) %>%
    select(geoid.x, geometry)
  
  # Join onto your predictions and pivot long:
  la_pred_sf <- la_geom %>%
    left_join(predictions_df, by = "geoid.x") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = actual:KNN,
      names_to  = "model",
      values_to = "grade"
    )
  
  # Graphing
  g <- ggplot(la_pred_sf) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = grade)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "HOLC Grade", na.value = "grey90") +
    facet_grid(~model) +
    #labs(title = "Actual vs. Predicted HOLC Grades for", area) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  plot_list[[area]] <<- g
  
  print(g)
  
  imp <- importance(model.rf_test_best)
  imp[order(imp[, "MeanDecreaseGini"], decreasing = TRUE)]
  varImpPlot(model.rf_test_best, n.var = 10)
  
  # Bind the columns
  bind_cols(test_areas = area, res)
}) %>% bind_rows()

res
```
